families.hypothesis: A closed-candle breakout failure exposes trapped directional liquidity.
families.economicLogic: A failed acceptance beyond a recent range level can create forced exits and short-horizon reversal flow.
families.detector: Prior closed candles probe and close beyond a 20-bar level; the current closed candle rejects back through that level.

families.hypothesis: A support breakdown followed by a bounded retest can expose overhead supply.
families.economicLogic: Former support becomes an invalidation reference after trapped longs test it from below.
families.detector: A prior closed candle breaks a 20-bar floor and the current closed candle retests and rejects that floor.

families.hypothesis: A bounded pullback inside an established higher-timeframe trend may resume the prevailing flow.
families.economicLogic: A controlled reset can improve entry location while trend alignment supplies directional continuation pressure.
families.detector: Closed-candle trend alignment, bounded pullback depth, and directional re-acceleration; no next-bar fields are read.

families.hypothesis: A measured release from compressed range can produce a directional event before late chasing.
families.economicLogic: Stored range energy plus participation can create temporary order-flow imbalance.
families.detector: Closed compression/range statistics followed by closed-candle range and participation expansion.

families.hypothesis: Synchronous benchmark weakness can improve the base rate of local downside momentum events.
families.economicLogic: Cross-market risk reduction can reinforce local supply and reduce isolated-symbol mean reversion.
families.detector: Already-closed BTC/ETH regime context, breadth, and local bearish momentum only.

candidateEvents.capPolicy: Frozen V5.9 chronological stride cap before labels and independent of returns.

development.use: Training and purged nested walk-forward selection only.

untouched.use: New final untouched-symbol validation only; excluded from selection.

rules.positiveLabel: POSITIVE when fixed-cost net R > 0; HIGH_QUALITY when fixed-cost net R >= +0.5R
rules.decision: SEND when expectedNetR = pWin * avgWinR + (1 - pWin) * avgLossR is strictly greater than the preregistered EV margin.
rules.probabilitySource: Model probability is fit only on the outer-fold training rows for the selected risk template.
rules.payoffSource: avgWinR and avgLossR are calculated only from the same outer-fold training rows; validation and holdout outcomes never set the payoff.
rules.costMargin: Net-R outcomes already include fixed fee, slippage, and funding; EV margins 0.05R/0.10R/0.15R add a preregistered positive-cost buffer.
rules.oldHoldout: The V5.9 20-symbol holdout is BURNED_AFTER_ZERO_SIGNAL_REVIEW and POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.

newHoldout.selection: Archive availability, month-precision listing window, and a pre-registered static liquidity proxy only.
newHoldout.gate: >=50 signals, >=10 symbols, NetR>0, AvgR>0, PF>=1.20, +10bps NetR>0, positive-symbol ratio>=0.60.
newHoldout.insufficient: Fewer than 50 signals is INCONCLUSIVE and cannot promote email.
